state_budget_rule.interpretation: The exact causal counter is fixed; only the certified evidence refinement grows. Total external-state bytes divided by model parameters must strictly decrease.

development_disclosure: The original 4K development curve failed at the middle-to-large transition due 1.7B Foundation saturation. A new-seed 8K difficulty screen produced increasing gains .1833/.3278/.4333 but exposed an unreserved chat-wrapper length warning. Confirmation uses three entirely new seeds generated at 8000 total base-template tokens; pre-score tokenization proves prompt plus 50 generated tokens is at most 8029 for every endpoint.
causal_memory_invariant: Only six-letter coded tokens between the official FWE context marker and the held-out final question are counted. The official outputs field is used solely for a post-read parser audit and scoring. Exceeding 256 unique codes is a hard failure.
certified_fusion_invariant: ASCENT appends only target-blind top-frequency words decoded from the bounded causal counter to the exact frozen Foundation output. The Foundation text is retained byte-for-byte, so certified evidence cannot remove an already correct reference.
measurement_boundary: Foundation is one exact greedy full-context decode. Fixed and scale ASCENT scores append certified counter evidence without a second neural decode. Counter time/state and model decode time/memory are reported separately.
confirmation_gate: Every seed must have positive scale gain at every endpoint and positive adjacent gain differences. Across three equally weighted seeds, every endpoint gain, both adjacent differences, and the slope on natural-log model parameters must have t(2) 95% lower confidence bounds above zero. There must be no scale regressions; expanded state must beat fixed one-word evidence at 360M and 1.7B; parser, model/data/config/clean-tree, native-length, and decreasing relative-state gates must all pass.
